title: Query-Guided RoPE Modulation for Lost-in-the-Middle Mitigation in Long-Context LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.09554v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context language models often neglect information in the middle of the input, a phenomenon known as "lost-in-the-middle". Part of this gap may stem from the long-range decay of rotary position embedding (RoPE), which weakens the positional signal between distant tokens. Existing input compression deletes low-importance tokens, and attention reweighting acts only after RoPE has weakened this signal. RoPE-level methods modify positions directly but apply the same remapping to every query. To address these limitations, we propose QGPM (Query-Guided Positional Modulation), a training-free method that reshapes RoPE positions using query relevance from the model's own attention heads. QGPM builds a broad relevance map for lower layers and a sharp one for upper layers. translated_title: 面向长上下文大语言模型“迷失在中间”问题缓解的查询引导RoPE调制
translated_abstract: 长上下文语言模型常常忽略输入中间部分的信息，这一现象被称为“迷失在中间”。造成这一差距的部分原因可能源于旋转位置编码的长程衰减，它削弱了远距离词元之间的位置信号。现有的输入压缩方法会删除低重要性的词元，而注意力重加权方法只在RoPE已经削弱该信号之后才起作用。RoPE层面的方法直接修改位置，但对每个查询都应用相同的重映射。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了QGPM（查询引导位置调制），这是一种无需训练的方法，利用模型自身注意力头产生的查询相关性来重塑RoPE位置。QGPM在较低层构建宽泛的相关性映射，在较高层构建尖锐的相关性映射。低相关性词元在快速旋转平面上前进不足一个位置，从而将相关证据拉近查询。慢速旋转平面则保持原始布局……
tldr: 提出QGPM，一种无需训练的方法，利用模型自身注意力头的查询相关性动态重塑RoPE位置编码，从而缓解长上下文大语言模型中“迷失在中间”的问题。
en_tdlr: QGPM, a training-free method that dynamically reshapes RoPE positional encoding using query relevance from the model's own attention heads, mitigating the "lost-in-the-middle" problem in long-context LLMs.
